goal: Make the first free Google Play build stop selling what does not exist: open the guides and decks marked premium-preview to every account, remove Premium upsell copy and dead Upgrade buttons, show dates in the user's language, and keep the floating Oracle launcher off the Journal composer.
successCriteria: A free account can open and chat with every guide and draw with every deck that is marked premium-preview; no Upgrade button, Premium lock panel or premium-preview badge is shown to that account.
Astrology AI keeps its existing server-side Premium entitlement and client gate unchanged; content marked premium (none today) stays locked.

The Profile usage section is titled as today's usage, shows no Premium marketing or broken title, and its copy no longer promises that Premium unlocks more readings; the owner tier preview tools stay available to owners.
Journal entries, Journal detail, Council session and zodiac history dates render with the app language locale (for Vietnamese: 28/10/2026 00:49), not the browser or device default.
The floating Oracle launcher is hidden while the Journal composer is open, so it no longer covers Save.
npm --workspace apps/mobile run check and the mobile Jest suite pass, and a 390x844 web walkthrough confirms a premium-preview guide opens chat and a premium-preview deck can be drawn.
untouchedSurfaces: The local daily tarot reading limit (3) and the server AI quota policy (1 AI one-card reading per day) are not changed; aligning them is an Owner product decision reported separately.
Astrology AI entitlement, backend functions, Supabase schema, credits ledger and Admin are unchanged.
Seed data keeps accessTier values so a later paid release can re-enable locks by flipping one constant; persona and deck content, artwork and brand assets are unchanged.
Admin and owner diagnostic screens keep their raw tier labels and existing timestamp format.

impact.entryPoint: Explore deck rail and deck chooser, Chat guide list and guide detail, Council invite list, Profile usage section, Journal tab and composer.
impact.dataWrite: No new data or storage keys. Readings with former preview decks and chats with former preview guides write the same local Journal and message shapes as free ones.
impact.backendContract: No endpoint or payload change. Persona chat and tarot endpoints do not check content tiers today; Astrology AI keeps premium_astrology_ai entitlement on the server.
impact.canonicalContract: accessTier in packages/content/data and apps/mobile/src/types.ts stays the source of truth; apps/mobile/src/features/owner/tierPreview.ts becomes the single place that maps premium-preview to free while FREE_LAUNCH is true.
impact.adminVisibility: No Admin change; Admin still lists raw tiers so operators see which content will lock again when purchases exist.
impact.privacySafety: No new data collection. Removing Upgrade buttons that did nothing avoids a store-review risk of advertising unavailable purchases.
impact.observability: The premium_deck_preview event stops firing for preview decks because they are no longer blocked; other events unchanged.
impact.rollback: Set FREE_LAUNCH to false or revert the commit to restore the previous locks and copy; no data migration is involved.
impact.surfacesIntentionallyUntouched: Daily quota numbers, Astrology AI gate, backend, Admin and content data were reviewed and left unchanged.
impact.agentHandoff: The delivery agent owns only the writeScope, uses a local test account, runs type check, Jest and a web walkthrough, and stops before commit, push, backend, release or account actions unless the Owner asks.

canonicalContracts: Owner decision 2026-10-23 recorded in docs/HANDOFF_CURRENT_STATE.vi.md: the first Play release is free and sells no Premium.
apps/mobile/src/features/owner/tierPreview.ts canViewContentTier is the only client gate for content tiers.
packages/agent-config/ai-usage-policy.json freeDaily defines AI quotas and is not changed here.
